assign.request: Find out why agents keep shipping content with no padding, and fix the system, not just one card. (The owner, on card 2026/09/25/now; .pad stays opt-in per the owner's correction.)
steps: Root cause: read skills + checkers, measure the Now card
Minion A: edge check sees neighbours, controls, framed boxes; skips .bleed
Minion B: page skill asks width / padding / neighbours every time
Wire the check into on-landing and hand it to smoke.mjs
Post findings on the card, land

log.msg: Root cause measured: padding-check.mjs reports 0 violations on the Now card with its padding stripped (80 text nodes). It climbs ancestors for a painted box; the edge is a neighbour's (the inbox column), so it never sees it. It also skips controls and framed boxes, and it only runs by hand; on-landing's layout-check never measures padding.

decision.question: Make padding the structural default, or keep .pad opt-in?
options: Default pad on every tab/content region with an opt-out
Keep .pad opt-in; the page skill asks and the landing check catches the forgotten ones
decision.why: The owner's correction: 'Sometimes we don't want padding and we don't want to have to fight it off.' .bleed is the existing opt-out word the check respects.

text: Minion B: page skill step 4 rewritten as three questions (width, padding .pad/.card/.bleed, neighbours), full-bleed trap named, padding-check command added; grew by about 7 lines.

agent.outcome: page skill step 4 rewritten: width / padding (.pad, .card or .bleed) / neighbours, the full-bleed trap, how to run the check; +7 lines

log.msg: Caveat for the sub-mastermind skill: mcp wait_for_agent returned timed-out after ~1 minute, not its timeout_s; I misread that as a stuck minion and a priority-now nudge cancelled its turn. Use the background curl wait instead.

Minion A, before counts (old padding-check.mjs, widths 400/1280/1920/3440): Now card stripped 0/0/0/0 violations (76 text nodes scanned); Now card as shipped 0/0/0/0; /framework/styles/ 0/0/0/0; /framework/core/Page/ 0/0/0/0; /framework/ai2/ 0/0/0/0. Second cause found: the tab panel's ancestor .ai2-full has overflow-x auto only because it scrolls vertically, so the old check called it a horizontal scroller and skipped the whole panel.

Minion A rewrite: Server/padding-check.mjs now looks sideways. Ink = text line boxes + controls (button, .btn, input incl. checkbox, select, textarea) + framed boxes (bordered or own ground; bands that fill their row, seamless runs of one colour, table cells, resize grips and columns taller than 60% of the viewport are regions, not ink). For each side it samples 0.5..3.5px outside with elementFromPoint: past the viewport, past the routed page's box, on a block's border, or on a different ground = touching. Skips .bleed / [data-bleed] only at or inside the routed page (the ai2 app wraps everything in .ai2.bleed, and that must not excuse the content). Only real horizontal scrollers (scrollWidth > clientWidth) are skipped. Off-screen ink is scrolled into view and every scroller restored. New export edges(urls, {base, widths}) returns {url, width, violations, worst, scanned, error?} rows.

Minion A proof (a) Now card, padding stripped: FAIL at all four widths, 7-8 findings each. At 1280: the question text 'Can you put everything on this page into a t...' at 0px from the page's own edge (and 0px from the chat column's border on its right), the four checkbox marks (the outline rows' check glyphs, outline.js ai2-ol-mark) at 0px, the stat tile control '0 To do' at 0px, the framed box 'Show the files in this card's folder' at 0px. Marking the same stripped tab page .bleed brings it to 0, so the opt-out works.

Minion A proof (b)+(c), after counts at 400/1280/1920/3440: Now card as shipped 0/0/0/0 (116-125 pieces of ink); /framework/styles/ 0/0/0/0 (214-226 ink); /framework/core/Page/ 0/0/0/0 (51-67 ink); /framework/ai2/ 1/1/0/0. That one is real, not a false positive: the Live card's 'Assistant: ask it about what is running' button (summary.ai2-live-assistant-row) sits at 0px against the inbox column's border at 400 and 1280, confirmed by screenshot. No false-positive flood. Intermediate false positives removed on the way: table cells, adjacent tabs, ext/Doc's title well + tab bar (one band in two boxes, and wrapped at 400px), the demo resize grip.

assign.outcome:
**The padding check now catches forgotten padding, and runs by itself on every landing.** Findings: [the card](/framework/ai2/2026/09/25/why-padding-keeps-going-missing/)

- [x] why are we still missing padding: the old check scored the unpadded Now card clean (it never counted a neighbour column as an edge) and only ran by hand. Tree + shots on the card.

- [x] checked automatically: Server/on-landing.mjs runs it; a test landing flagged the real AI 2 miss.
- [x] layout questions every time, in the page skill: how wide, does it need padding (.pad / .card / .bleed), how does it meet its neighbours.
- [x] padding stays opt-in (your correction).
- [ ] pre-merge smoke test: edges() handed to the smoke.mjs builders, not built yet.
